description: Source code for Node.js internal CommonJS module loader, including module resolution, package reading, and extension handling.

methods.name: stat
methods.description: Checks if a file exists and returns its status, utilizing cache if available.

methods.name: readPackage
methods.description: Reads and parses package.json for a given path, with caching.

methods.name: readPackageScope
methods.description: Traverses parent directories to find a package.json, excluding node_modules directories.

methods.name: tryPackage
methods.description: Attempts to resolve a package's main file or index with extensions.

methods.name: tryFile
methods.description: Checks if a file exists, resolving symlinks based on options.

methods.name: toRealPath
methods.description: Resolves the real path of a file, utilizing cache.

methods.name: tryExtensions
methods.description: Attempts to find a file with any of the given extensions.

methods.name: trySelfParentPath
methods.description: Returns the filename of the parent module or current working directory.

methods.name: trySelf
methods.description: Resolves self-referential module paths based on package exports.

methods.name: resolveExports
methods.description: Resolves package exports for scoped or named modules.

methods.name: finalizeEsmResolution
methods.description: Finalizes ESM resolution, converting URLs to paths and checking file existence.

methods.name: createEsmNotFoundErr
methods.description: Creates a MODULE_NOT_FOUND error for unresolved modules.
